summary: ARC Group Securities Acquisition I, a Cayman-incorporated blank-check company trading on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K announcing that beginning on or about September 24, 2026, holders may separately trade the Class A ordinary shares, warrants and rights underlying its units. Each unit comprises one Class A share, one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share, and one right to receive one-fourth of a Class A share upon an initial business combination. Unseparated units continue trading as FJDIU; separated securities trade as FJDI, FJDIW and FJDIR. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, premium or closing date are stated. What to watch: whether a business combination is ultimately announced and whether redeemer overhang and trust size affect deal viability.
